_note: Cap rules for 2026-27 trades under the 2023 CBA. Every number the checker uses comes from this file. Amounts in dollars. See _sources for where each value came from; values marked VERIFY are derived and worth checking against the NBA's official cap memo.

_sources.salary_cap, tax_line, first_apron, secon: User's 2026-27 cap sheet; matches the league's announced 2026-27 figures.
_sources.salary_matching.tiers: 2023 CBA tiers. 2025-26 values per Hoops Rumors ($8,527,000 / $33,108,000, middle tier = outgoing + $8,527,000). 2026-27: lower break = $7.5M x (2026-27 cap / 2023-24 cap $136,021,000), rounded to $1,000 = $9,096,000; upper break = where tiers 2 and 3 meet (4 x $9,096,000 - $1,000,000). Fanspo shows these as $9.1M and $35.2M. VERIFY the upper break.
_sources.salary_matching.max_percent_above_first_: 2023 CBA: a team at or above the first apron after a trade may take back at most 100% of outgoing salary.
_sources.salary_matching.cap_room_cushion: Fanspo trade rules: a team under the cap can absorb salary into its room plus $100K.
_sources.trade_exception: 2023 CBA: a traded player exception absorbs salary up to its amount plus $250K; not usable above the second apron; one created in a prior season is not usable above the first apron (and using it hard-caps the team at the first apron).
_sources.aggregation.recently_acquired_days: 2023 CBA: a player acquired by trade can't be combined with other salaries for two months.
_sources.cash.max_per_season: 5.15% of the salary cap ($164,961,000 x 0.0515, rounded). VERIFY.
_sources.roster: Per the project spec: each team must end a trade with 14-15 standard contracts.
_sources.signing_restrictions: Free agents: later of Dec 15 or three months after signing. Re-signed with a raise over 20%: Jan 15. Dates from the user's 2026-27 league calendar.
_sources.draft: Stepien Rule: a team can't be without a first-round pick in two consecutive future drafts, looking seven drafts ahead (2027-2033).
